details:
Since 2026.3.3 moved the PC client to Unity 6, players crash to desktop while loading into our world, After Dark Club (wrld_3edb543b-bd8e-4ae0-8592-93678bc62456). It happens several times every busy night. Players' logs from before the switch show none of these crashes.

CRASH SIGNATURE

(Windows Reliability Monitor on an affected PC; no Unity "Crashes" folder was written)

- APPCRASH, VRChat.exe 6000.0.67.6863

- Fault module: UnityPlayer.dll 6000.0.67.6863 (timestamp 6ac55b52)

- Exception code: c0000005 (access violation)

- Exception offset: 0x0000000000b11b2d

- Bucket ID: 766c1fa51efc85364d935189e381e1a7

- Client: 2026.3.3p2 build 1921, Unity 6000.0.67f1-DWR, Windows 11 26200, RTX 4060 Ti 8 GB, 32 GB RAM, SteamVR

WHEN IT HAPPENS

(the victim's own output log; it ends with no exception)

1. "Entering Room: After Dark Club" at T+0.

2. "Room instantiate took 4.95s", then "Spent 8.77s waiting to discover master client". Mirror shader warm-up ran during that time.

3. At T+10, "Spawning players" -> "Finished spawning players" (16 players). Avatars initialise, and the world's Udon Start() methods run in the same second.

4. The log ends at T+11, mid-load, after "Initialize Limb Avatar VRCPlayer[Remote] 1". The local OnPlayerJoined never fired. No video player had opened a URL.

5. Other players see "Player X did not receive initial data in time, forcing spawn" at about +15 s, then the player leaves at +25 to 40 s.

HOW OFTEN

(counted from the master's logs; "crash-retry" = a player who leaves within 45 s of joining twice within 10 minutes)

- 2026-09-28, Unity 2022.3.22: 384 joins, 2% left within 45 s, 0 crash-retries

- 2026-10-02 to 04, Unity 2022.3.22: 483 joins, 3% left within 45 s, 0 crash-retries

- 2026-10-12, Unity 6000.0.67: 107 joins, 16% left within 45 s, 4 crash-retries

- 2026-10-16, Unity 6000.0.67: 204 joins, 11% left within 45 s, 9 crash-retries

- 2026-10-17, Unity 6000.0.67: 171 joins, 11% left within 45 s, 4 crash-retries

- 2026-10-20 to 21, Unity 6000.0.67: 224 joins, 23% left within 45 s, 9 crash-retries

WHAT WE KNOW ABOUT IT

- It scales with the instance's crowd. Short stays were 8-9% at 5-14 players, 17-19% at 15-24, and 29% at 25+. Later in a long night, most joiners take more than 15 s to load.

- It is not one PC or one save. The same player crashed 11 s into a rejoin after playing 5.5 hours in the same instance that night. Others crash 2-4 times in a row, then get in.

- It is not the video player. No AVPro URL was opened before the crash; our stream now starts 15 s after the join.

- We already lightened the join. We reduced per-player networked objects from 66 to 6 and delayed the stream. The crash rate did not change.

- It is PC only, as far as we can tell. We have no reports from Quest.

WHAT WOULD HELP

- Symbolicating UnityPlayer.dll 6000.0.67.6863 + 0xb11b2d to name the crashing function, so we know what to avoid in the world.

- Whether this bucket appears in your crash telemetry for other large worlds.
title: PC client (Unity 6, build 1921) crashes in UnityPlayer.dll (c0000005 @ 0xb11b2d) while joining a busy world
